scope: Only three byte-array populations. This payload never activates a B2 lease. No DTO or across-runner absolute pooling.
percentConvention: AB=(B/A-1)*100; AA=(right/left-1)*100; all unrounded pair values and same-cell aggregates retained.

verification.derivation: original per-process integer totals plus complete per-RPC ticks/worker/fairness CSV; no summary metrics as input
verification.relativeChangeConvention: AB=(B/A-1)*100; AA=(right/left-1)*100; report median and geometric mean within same cell/population
limitations: No cross-runner or DTO absolute-metric pooling.
Byte-array codec is unsized; these runs never activate a B2 lease.
Observed call/stream settlement is not proof that all credit, SendPump or late WU has settled.
Jain measures RPC completion distribution, not stream-credit scheduler fairness.
N/1000 is nominal tail size; no effective sample-size correction or tail-confidence claim.
CPU/allocation process totals include client, server and payload validation; not controller-only costs.
A native ELF and executed hash prove an actual AOT run; source provenance relies additionally on saved build commands/logs and compiled reports.

crossReaderComparison.method: Only after both readers derived results independently, compare raw-source hashes, process counters, identities, every shared AB pair value and same-cell AA ratios/aggregates.
